# DynamicSynchronyMetric

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A measurable indicator derived from oscillator phase alignment that quantifies the degree of dynamic coordination between network nodes over time. Serves as a runtime health/performance metric for TCC interconnects, allowing adaptive reconfiguration of topology based on synchronization quality.
